leavePolicies.title: Leave policies
leavePolicies.subtitle: Global parameters, per-fiscal-year leave policies and version history (effective-dated).
leavePolicies.settingsHint: System-wide parameters — change here, not on the Leave quota page.
leavePolicies.periodComboHint: Only 2 valid combos: start = 1 and end ≥ 29, OR start = end + 1 (contiguous)
leavePolicies.minWorkPercentHint: Actual working days × 100 / period working days ≥ threshold → 1 eligible period (default 50)
leavePolicies.requirePolicyApprovalHint: On: a version must go through Submit → Approve before Activate. Off: activate straight from draft.
leavePolicies.currentHint: The in-force policy of the year — create new versions / run the approval workflow here.
leavePolicies.historyHint: All versions across all years — act by status (draft → pending → active…).
leavePolicies.effectiveFromHint: Empty = fiscal-year start. Must fall inside the fiscal year and after the current version.

confirm.activate: Activate {{year}} V{{version}}? The current version will expire.
confirm.activatePast: Effective date {{date}} is in the past — the policy will apply from that date and may affect already-calculated periods. Activate anyway?

security.title: Security
